title: Google Drive sync + diff of final case folder

last_report.msg: Drive sync built+run: new=3 (README.md, example-scenarios.md, sources/emails/attachments/2026-10-08-statement-debt-analysis.md) changed=1 (sources/emails/2026-09-24-kickoff-questions.txt: ozan@ -> ozan.er@ in Cc) missing=0; test-customers.json unchanged (34 cust, 617 pairs); local case folder now mirrors Drive; scripts in scratchpad drive_sync.sh/drive_watch.sh

spec:
GOAL: the organizers keep updating the final-case files in a PUBLIC Google Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1r9KOek3SXiE0mu1wBofezD0bjiAJhcYQ . Build a repeatable sync so we always run on the latest files. Be fast (≤15 min).
1. Write /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ulas-Desktop-Freya/57eb871d-3581-44e5-a48d-daea97c23a2e/scratchpad/drive_sync.sh (and helper python if needed) that downloads the whole folder tree (recursively, keeping relative paths) into a fresh dir /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ulas-Desktop-Freya/57eb871d-3581-44e5-a48d-daea97c23a2e/scratchpad/drive/<UTC timestamp>/ . Preferred: create a throwaway venv /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ulas-Desktop-Freya/57eb871d-3581-44e5-a48d-daea97c23a2e/scratchpad/venv-gdown (python3 -m venv) and pip install gdown there (NOT into the project venv), then gdown --folder <url> -O <dir> --remaining-ok. Fallback if gdown fails: scrape https://drive.google.com/embeddedfolderview?id=<folderId> (lists files + subfolders with ids), recurse into subfolders, download files via https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=<id>&export=download&confirm=t . Google Docs/Sheets (if any) export as text/markdown/csv.
2. Compare the downloaded tree with the local case folder "/Users/ulas/Desktop/Freya/Build the Builder - Final Case" (ignore .DS_Store): list NEW / CHANGED (sha256) / MISSING files. For changed text files, write unified diffs to /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ulas-Desktop-Freya/57eb871d-3581-44e5-a48d-daea97c23a2e/scratchpad/drive/<ts>-diff.txt ; for test-customers.json report record-count/keys change and whether any request/response pair changed.
3. If there are new/changed files: copy them into "/Users/ulas/Desktop/Freya/Build the Builder - Final Case" (keep a backup of the previous version of each changed file in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ulas-Desktop-Freya/57eb871d-3581-44e5-a48d-daea97c23a2e/scratchpad/drive/backup-<ts>/ ), so the local case folder mirrors Drive. Never delete local files that are missing on Drive — just report them.
4. Print a one-line machine-readable summary at the end: SYNC <ts> new=N changed=M missing=K files=<comma list>.
5. Run it once now and report. Also write /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ulas-Desktop-Freya/57eb871d-3581-44e5-a48d-daea97c23a2e/scratchpad/drive_watch.sh: loops every 300 s running drive_sync.sh and EXITS (code 0) as soon as a sync reports new>0 or changed>0, printing the summary (so the orchestrator gets notified); stops after 3 h.
Do not modify the git repo. Final report ≤15 lines: what changed vs our local copy right now (file list + 1-line gist each), and the exact commands to run the sync and the watcher.
